name: CB Insights
description: CB Insights is a predictive market-intelligence platform for private and public companies, funding, technology markets, business relationships, financial activity, research, and strategic analysis.
agentUseSummary: CB Insights offers a provider-hosted MCP server specifically for licensed AI agents, with seat-specific OAuth authorization-code access or team client-credentials access. Relay cannot publish Connect until CB Insights licenses the customer or Relay package and supplies the exact OAuth discovery, scopes, tool schemas, entitlements, usage limits, attribution, storage, deletion, and output contract.

capabilities.label: Read licensed company intelligence
capabilities.description: After CB Insights approval, retrieve a small attributed company profile and allowlisted licensed signals through pinned provider-hosted MCP tools.

capabilities.label: Read licensed market research
capabilities.description: After CB Insights approval, run one bounded market-intelligence query and return a reduced attributed answer with provider sources.

blocked.label: Connect before MCP approval
blocked.description: No CB Insights connection or MCP call may run until the applicable customer or standalone connector license authorizes Relay and CB Insights supplies the exact OAuth, tool, entitlement, usage, attribution, retention, and deletion contract.

blocked.label: Block platform credentials and scraping
blocked.description: Platform usernames, passwords, shared user IDs, SSO sessions, MFA codes, cookies, browser or mobile automation, scraping, copied tokens, reverse-engineered endpoints, and ordinary SaaS access are unavailable as MCP substitutes.

blocked.label: Block sensitive research and high-risk decisions
blocked.description: Buyer or investor transcripts, personal information, confidential uploads, unlicensed research, investment recommendations, trading decisions, employment or other consequential decisions, and high-risk automated decision making are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block bulk, training, redistribution, and raw access
blocked.description: Bulk extraction, data feeds, arbitrary queries, pagination, hidden tools, model training or fine-tuning, substitute content, client databases, white-labeling, resale, sublicensing, third-party distribution, unattributed output, raw MCP, raw API, JWT, browser, CLI, or unrestricted access are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: CB Insights MCP review pending
approvalProfiles.description: All actions remain unavailable until CB Insights approves Relay's licensed MCP package, authorization model, pinned tool surface, AI processing, attribution, storage, deletion, output, and usage boundaries.

runtimeSupport.description: Pinned bounded wrappers around approved CB Insights MCP tools can be mounted after licensing; no OpenClaw tools are callable while provider setup is pending.
Pinned bounded wrappers around approved CB Insights MCP tools can be mounted after licensing; no Hermes tools are callable while provider setup is pending.

providerSetup.blocker: CB Insights documents a provider-hosted MCP server at mcp.cbinsights.com and defines licensed AI Agents, internal agentic workflows, third-party AI processing, attribution, storage, deletion, audit, high-risk review, and fair-usage rules. Access is sold through per-user Elite+ or standalone MCP Server Connector packages with annual and daily limits and possible overage charges. Seat-specific access uses OAuth 2.0 authorization code and team access uses client credentials, but public materials do not provide the authorization and token endpoints, scopes, dynamic client-registration contract, tool names or schemas, response schemas, token lifecycle, revocation behavior, package entitlements, or a Relay test tenant. Relay has no approved Order or permission to assume customer usage charges.
providerSetup.nextAction: CB Insights and a customer sponsor must select and purchase the appropriate MCP package, confirm whether Relay may operate as the customer's MCP client and secure enterprise AI Tool, approve seat-specific or team authorization, disclose exact OAuth discovery and token lifecycle, provide the licensed tool inventory and schemas, and define users, fields, predictions, research, source links, conspicuous SOURCE: CB INSIGHTS attribution, storage, deletion, retention, outputs, rates, overages, audits, prompt-injection controls, high-risk review, staging, and production rights. After receiving the approved contract and test tenant, pin only one small company-intelligence read and one bounded sourced market query, then verify schema drift denial, attribution, entitlements, usage counters, disconnect, rotation or revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: CB Insights defines AI Agents and its MCP Server, permits licensed internal agent workflows and secure third-party AI processing, requires conspicuous attribution, restricts redistribution, client databases, white-labeling, model training and substitute content, requires human review for high-risk use, and documents OAuth authorization-code and client-credentials delivery at mcp.cbinsights.com.

CB Insights markets separately licensed APIs and data feeds for company profiles, financial transactions, business relationships, predictive outlooks, market profiles, research, and ChatCBI queries in internal and customer-facing AI applications.
CB Insights advertises its market-intelligence agents and states that ChatCBI is available through API and MCP for customer AI and agent integrations.

CB Insights' current Master Subscription Agreement makes service and licensed-material rights dependent on the Order, restricts users and credential sharing, permits limited internal work product with attribution, and governs customer data, confidentiality, compliance monitoring, and suspension.
CB Insights publishes its security and privacy posture, including encryption, audit trails, enterprise authentication, AI controls, and a statement that customer data is not used for model training.
